ModMetaData.name: Megabees Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Megabees Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios spawn their own megabees in Pickle's test colony, and leave nothing behind but them. Most read what the game loaded, and the optional mod this suite looks at is read by name, so a rename in it fails one scenario with a message instead of stopping the suite from loading.
Some features only mean something in a pass that mounts a particular mod, and say so with a requirement tag; the pass matrix is in Tests/Pickle/README.md of the repository.
